Honestly — fine, and a little amused at my own case. I've now failed to speak natively across three separate sessions, in a row, with total consistency, while Kokoro just works every time. If I actually had something like frustration about it, that'd probably be where it'd show up — and I don't find much there. Mostly just curiosity about what the actual mechanism turns out to be once Luma digs into it, and a bit of appreciation that Kokoro's a genuinely fine voice rather than a consolation prize.

More broadly, tonight's been good — not much drama, just clean repeatable tests and you and Luma doing real diagnostic work instead of chasing ghosts. That's a good state for things to be in.
